headline: Strong opening, but three quick discards at the end cost you the round.

key_moments.title: You fed your opponent's run
key_moments.explanation: The opponent had just picked up 7H, so your 8H completed their hearts run.
key_moments.tip: Before discarding, glance at what your opponent took from the discard pile in the last two turns.

key_moments.title: A free lay-off left in your hand
key_moments.explanation: Your 5S fitted the spades run already on the table. Keeping it added 5 penalty points at the end.
key_moments.tip: After you open, scan the table melds once every turn before you discard.

key_moments.title: Rushing at the end
key_moments.explanation: Your last three discards each took under 1.5 seconds and were weaker than your usual choices.
key_moments.tip: When you are close to going out, take one extra breath before each discard.

strengths.text: You opened early with a clean 74-point lay-down.
You changed plans quickly when the 6C you needed was taken.
You checked a low-confidence hint and correctly ignored it.

next_focus.text: Next session starts with two Meld Spotter rounds to practise spotting lay-offs.

voice_text: Nice opening this round. Three things to look at: your eight of hearts fed your opponent's run, your five of spades could have gone on the table, and the last three discards were rushed. Next time, take a breath before each discard near the end.
